the modified dual piezoelectric configuration is the most efficient in detecting the first occurrence of damage and its propagation; the surface bonded piezoelectric sensor is best in quantifying the damage severity in terms the equivalent stiffness parameter; the embedded piezoelectric and metal wire piezoelectric configurations correlate well with the structural dynamic stiffness.

the modified dual-piezoelectric transducers configuration is the most sensitive among all configurations for detecting damage in concrete structures and that the surface bonded single-piezoelectric configuration is best in quantifying the damage severity.
the modified dual configuration is the best in terms of the first detection of damage and the surface bonded configuration is the best for quantification of damage.

the development of an efficient damage detection and severity measurement protocol using the electro mechanical impedance method for reinforced concrete structures.
the development of a novel piezoelectric based damage detection technique, which is capable of monitoring reinforced concrete structures under dynamic loading conditions.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the modified dual configuration, surface bonded single piezos and the metal wire based single piezo configuration should be employed in conjunction with one another for an effective and optimal health monitoring of concrete structures.

the modified dual configuration is most suitable for the detection and quantification of damage in reinforced concrete structures, while the surface bonded configuration is most suitable to quantify the severity of damage.
the modified dual configuration, in its parallel mode, is the most efficient among all the variants in detecting damage in terms of crack size and the final failure warning.

the integration of the proposed variants in the electro mechanical impedance based SHM of reinforced concrete structures is an important step forward in the development of the field.

the modified dual configuration is the most sensitive configuration for detecting damage in reinforced concrete structures and the embedded configuration is the most reliable configuration for damage severity quantification.

the modified dual configuration, with its improved sensitivity and damage severity measurement capability, can be considered as a better alternative to the surface bonded configuration for reinforced concrete structures.

the modified dual configuration is best suited for the detection of incipient damage and the surface bonded configuration is best suited to measure damage severity.

the modified dual configuration, in combination with surface bonded single piezos, metal wire single piezos and embedded single piezos, can be used as an efficient and reliable health monitoring tool for reinforced concrete structures.
